open_questions_for_vendor: Please confirm the exact legal entity that contracts with Tavus for the Salesforce CRM service — full legal name, legal form, and state/country of incorporation (e.g. 'Salesforce, Inc.', a Delaware corporation, or a regional Salesforce affiliate) — and provide that entity's registered office / principal place of business address.

Has the contracting Salesforce entity designated a representative in the EU under Article 27 GDPR (and in the UK under UK GDPR)? If Art. 27 does not apply because processing runs through EU-established Salesforce affiliates, please identify the relevant EU entity and its address.

Have you formally appointed a Data Protection Officer? Public materials reference a 'Salesforce Data Protection Officer (Salesforce Privacy Team)' reachable via privacy@salesforce.com — please confirm the authoritative DPO contact (name if publishable, telephone number and/or email address) entitled to respond to data-protection-related requests from customers, as SAP requires a named channel.

Which certifications and audit reports does Salesforce currently hold that cover the specific services Tavus uses (Sales Cloud CRM): SOC 1, SOC 2 Type II (period covered and Trust Service Criteria in scope), SOC 3, ISO 27001, ISO 27017, ISO 27018, ISO 27701, BS 25999/ISO 22301, other? Please provide the current SOC 2 Type II report and ISO certificates with scope statements (under NDA if required) so Tavus can place them on file.
What minimum TLS version (e.g. TLS 1.2, TLS 1.3) is enforced for data in transit to the Salesforce services Tavus uses (e.g. *.my.salesforce.com and API endpoints)?

Which encryption algorithm and key length are used for customer data at rest in Tavus's Salesforce org (database, file storage) on the standard platform WITHOUT the Shield Platform Encryption add-on, and what changes with Shield?
Are backups of customer data encrypted, and with which algorithm? Are backup encryption keys managed the same way as production keys?

Who generates and manages the encryption keys for customer data at rest (Salesforce-managed platform keys vs. tenant-specific keys vs. customer-held keys via Shield BYOK / Cache-Only Keys)? Please confirm key handling for an org WITHOUT Shield (keys generated by Salesforce, not customer-specific?).

Can Salesforce, acting as a processor, anonymize and/or pseudonymize personal data in the customer's PRODUCTION org on documented customer instruction (not only sandbox masking via Data Mask)? Which editions include this capability?

Beyond encryption, which other technical safeguards protect customer data (access controls and least-privilege for Salesforce personnel, MFA, event monitoring/audit trail, network segmentation, penetration testing cadence, vulnerability management, Hyperforce isolation controls)?

Does Salesforce offer EU data residency / an EU Operating Zone for the services Tavus uses? If yes: which data categories does it cover (customer data vs. metadata, logs, support access), on which infrastructure (Hyperforce EU regions), and is it available for Tavus's edition/contract?
